findings.question: Statutory health insurance: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Specificaţiile de Interfaţare cu SIUI+SIPE+CEAS pentru aplicaţiile de raportare ale furnizorilor de servicii medicale şi farmaceutice către Sistemul Informatic Unic Integrat al CNAS
findings.quote_english: The interface specifications with SIUI+SIPE+CEAS for the reporting applications of medical and pharmaceutical service providers to the Single Integrated Information System of CNAS
findings.value: Sistemul Informatic Unic Integrat al CNAS (SIUI) (Single Integrated Information System of the National Health Insurance House)
findings.title: Specificaţii de interfaţare cu PIAS - pentru producătorii de aplicaţii software
findings.publisher: Casa Naţională de Asigurări de Sănătate (CNAS), Portal CNAS-PIAS
findings.note: CNAS's own portal calls the system 'Sistemul Informatic Unic Integrat al CNAS', which attributes it to CNAS; cnas.ro (where CNAS states it organises and administers PIAS) and legislatie.just.ro refused automated access, so 'operated by' is not stated verbatim.

review.established: Sistemul Informatic Unic Integrat (SIUI) al CNAS
review.reason: The CNAS page publishes interface specifications for providers to report to the Sistemul Informatic Unic Integrat of CNAS (SIUI, with SIPE and CEAS).

findings.question: Tax: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: OPANAF nr. 3.792/24.07.2024 pentru aprobarea Procedurii privind modificarea din oficiu a datelor din Registrul contribuabililor/plătitorilor, precum și a modelului și conținutului unor formulare
findings.quote_english: ANAF President's Order no. 3,792/24.07.2024 approving the Procedure for the ex officio amendment of data in the Register of taxpayers/payers, and the model and content of certain forms
findings.title: Raport de performanță și transparență 2024
findings.note: ANAF's 2024 performance report names an actual tax register; the same report says that by end-2024 the RO e-Factura data module and intra-EU VAT fraud module were received under APIC, while the Big-Data platform itself is not described as complete.

review.reason: The ANAF 2024 performance report (text extracted from the PDF) lists OPANAF 3.792/2024 about changing data in the Registrul contribuabililor/plătitorilor ex officio; the quote names the register but not who operates it.
